newsitem.title: USA: Elan, Cytogen form joint company.
newsitem.headline: Elan, Cytogen form joint company.

text.p: Elan Corp and Cytogen Corp said on Thursday they agreed to create a new U.S.-based oncology-products company, called Targon Corp, which will initially be a wholly-owned subsidiary of Cytogen.
Elan made a $20 million investment in Cytogen, consisting of $5 million in common stock and $15 million in a new Series A convertible preferred stock.
Those proceeds will provide initial capital for Targon. Elan will have the right to have equal ownership in the new company, the two companies said.
Products for the new company will come from Elan's and Cytogen's existing pipelines and the in-licensing of additional late-stage oncology products.

"The new company creates a unique combination of competencies and provides an effective and efficient development channel for differentiated oncology products," said Michael Sember, Elan's vice president of planning, investments and development, who will serve as chief executive officer and chairman of Targon.
